text: And Job answered and said,
“Truly [it is] that you⁺ [are] the people, and wisdom will die with you⁺.
Also unto me [is] a heart like you⁺; I [am] not falling below you⁺. And with whom are not [things] like these?
I have become a laughingstock to his neighbor, one calling on God and He answered him, righteous [and] blameless—a laughingstock.
[There is] contempt for disaster in the thought of the secure, prepared for those slipping of foot.
The tents of robbers are at rest, and those disturbing God are secure—to the one who carries [his] god in his hand.
But ask now the beasts, and they will instruct you, and the birds of the heavens, and one will declare to you.
Or speak to the earth and it will instruct you, and the fish of the sea and they will recount to you.
Who among all these does not know that the hand of YHWH has done this—
in whose hand [is] the soul of every living [thing], and the breath of all the flesh of man?
Does not the ear examine words, and the mouth taste food for itself?
With the aged is wisdom, and in length of days is understanding.
With Him [are] wisdom and strength; unto Him [are] counsel and understanding.
Behold, He tears down, and it cannot be rebuilt; He closes [up] upon a man, and it cannot be opened.
Behold, He restrains the waters and they dry up, and He sends them forth and they overthrow the land.
With Him [are] strength and wisdom and unto Him [are] the deceived and the deceiver.
He leads away counselors barefoot, and judges He makes foolish.
The bond of kings He loosens, and He binds a waistband around their loins.
He leads away priests barefoot, and the established He overthrows.
He deprives the lip of the trusted ones, and the discernment of the elders He takes away.
He pours out contempt on nobles, and the mighty He makes feeble.
He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings to light the shadow of death.
He makes great nations, and destroys them; He enlarges nations and guides them away.
He turns aside the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, and makes them wander in a wilderness without a path.
They feel [about] [in] darkness without light, and He makes them stagger like a drunkard.
